name: hivehouse
description: Run a feature with a team of Claude sessions in tmux: plan, build, review, gate, rotate, overnight, clean up.

allow_attribution.title: Allow AI attribution trailers in commits
allow_attribution.description: When off, gates refuse commits carrying Co-Authored-By or similar trailers

files_per_commit.title: Most files per commit
files_per_commit.description: Gates warn or refuse commits touching more files than this

model_orchestrator.title: Orchestrator model
model_orchestrator.description: Model alias for the orchestrator session

window_orchestrator.title: Orchestrator context window (tokens)
window_orchestrator.description: Used only when Claude Code's own reading of the window is missing; never inferred from a model name

window_builder.title: Builder context window (tokens)
window_builder.description: Used only when Claude Code's own reading of the window is missing; never inferred from a model name

window_reviewer.title: Reviewer context window (tokens)
window_reviewer.description: Used only when Claude Code's own reading of the window is missing; never inferred from a model name

permission_mode_local.title: Agents' permission mode on this machine
permission_mode_local.description: Bypass permissions is never used locally, except while the hub is in delegate mode (the owner is away): that needs this set to auto

remote_hosts.title: Known remote hosts (comma-separated ssh names)
remote_hosts.description: ssh host names hivehouse may run overnight work on

dedicated_hosts.title: Remote hosts dedicated to agents (bypass allowed)
dedicated_hosts.description: Comma-separated ssh names where bypass permissions may be used, asked again each time

rotate_at_percent.title: Context level that triggers a handoff
rotate_at_percent.description: Percent of the context window at which an agent hands off and is cleared

overnight_ceiling_usd.title: Spending ceiling per overnight run (USD)
overnight_ceiling_usd.description: A project may only lower this

heartbeat_minutes.title: Overnight heartbeat interval (minutes)
heartbeat_minutes.description: How often the orchestrator checks context, disk, queue and spend

hub_auto_start.title: Hub names itself and greets
hub_auto_start.description: A plain claude started in the hub's folder names itself hub (or hub-2...) and opens the hub, which takes one model turn; when off, start it with claude --name hub /hivehouse:hub

hub_max_starts_per_day.title: Hub: sessions started or woken per day while away
hub_max_starts_per_day.description: Delegate mode: the most sessions the hub starts or wakes in 24 hours before it keeps the rest for you. A guideline the hub passes to hh-hub recover, not a guard

away_mcp_allow.title: Away: MCP servers an away hub may use
away_mcp_allow.description: Comma-separated MCP server names, or mcp__<server>__<tool>, loaded for the hub started by hh-hub away (none by default). Allowing a server allows its write tools too

min_free_gb.title: Free disk (GB) below which cleanup runs
min_free_gb.description: Below this, sessions get a low-disk warning and cleanup runs
